facts: LM8JC5MC: 8 mm, C mount, 2/3-inch 5 MP, 55 g; comparison candidate. LM12JC5MC: 12 mm, 55 g, earlier design reference. Actual sensor dimensions determine field of view.

title: TowerPro, MG90S Analog pitch servo
facts: 13.4g; no-load0.08s/60deg at6V. Loaded133ms settling interval is a design target.

title: Xu et al., FAST-LIO2, 2021
facts: Direct raw-point LiDAR-inertial odometry with incremental map; project comparison uses measurement modality, observability and compute implications.
bibliography: Wei Xu, Yixi Cai, Dongjiao He, Jiarong Lin, and Fu Zhang. FAST-LIO2: Fast Direct LiDAR-inertial Odometry. arXiv:2107.06829, 2021

title: Campos et al., ORB-SLAM3, 2021
facts: Feature-based visual/visual-inertial multi-map SLAM; map reuse and relocalisation.
bibliography: Carlos Campos, Richard Elvira, Juan J. Gómez Rodríguez, José M. M. Montiel, and Juan D. Tardós. ORB-SLAM3: An Accurate Open-Source Library for Visual, Visual-Inertial and Multi-Map SLAM. arXiv:2007.11898, 2021

title: Zheng et al., FAST-LIVO2, 2024 preprint / 2025 T-RO
facts: Direct LiDAR/image fusion via ESIKF sequential updates and unified voxel map; visual exposure handling. Primary deployment algorithm candidate.
bibliography: Chunran Zheng et al. FAST-LIVO2: Fast, Direct LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry. arXiv:2408.14035, 2024

title: Tordesillas et al., FASTER, T-RO
facts: Plans with a safe backup in known free space. Borrow backup-trajectory principle; use simpler low-speed aisle coverage planner.
bibliography: Jesus Tordesillas, Brett T. Lopez, Michael Everett, and Jonathan P. How. FASTER: Fast and Safe Trajectory Planner for Navigation in Unknown Environments. arXiv:2001.04420, 2021

title: PX4, external position estimation
facts: External odometry, coordinate frames, covariance and timing integration.

title: PX4, Offboard mode
facts: External setpoints and proof-of-life/offboard-loss handling; design uses explicit faster setpoint rates.

title: Hornung et al., OctoMap

bibliography: Armin Hornung, Kai M. Wurm, Maren Bennewitz, Cyrill Stachniss, and Wolfram Burgard. OctoMap: An Efficient Probabilistic 3D Mapping Framework Based on Octrees. Autonomous Robots, 34:189–206, 2013
